newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Andes buys into China food firm.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes buys into China food firm.

text.p: Pacific Andes International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had conditionally agreed to buy a 70 percent stake in food processing and distribution firm Pelican Food Ltd for 147 million yuan from Global Chart Ltd.

Pelican Food's principal asset is Qingdao Canning & Foodstuff Co Ltd, a foreign-owned enterprise established in China which processes and distributes food products in China and makes and exports food and packing products.
It said the cash acquisition would be financed by internal resources.
"The directors believe the acquisition will open the door to the PRC (People's Republic of China) retail market for the group," Pacific Andes said.
